sources.primary_title: Horizontal Digital Joins Salesforce at LEAP to Showcase Agentic AI and Digital Experience Innovation in Saudi Arabia
sources.verified_angle_summary: Horizontal Digital is partnering with Salesforce at LEAP 2026 to showcase a new 'Digital Concierge' demo built specifically for the travel, tourism, and hospitality sector. Powered by Salesforce Agentforce, this agentic AI experience demonstrates how guests can be guided from their initial inquiry through booking and on-site service in real time. The announcement underscores the shift in Saudi Arabia's digital landscape toward integrated experience ecosystems, moving beyond individual platforms to combine data, AI, and composable technologies. The initiative directly supports the practical execution of Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 goals, particularly in modernizing digital ecosystems for travel and real estate. This provides a distinct angle focusing on a specific agentic AI application in hospitality, rather than just a generic partnership announcement.
sources.verified_key_facts: Horizontal Digital is co-exhibiting with Salesforce at LEAP 2026 (August 31-September 3); The companies are showcasing a 'Digital Concierge' demo built on Salesforce Agentforce; The agentic AI solution targets the travel, tourism, and hospitality sector; The technology guides guests from first inquiry through booking and on-site service in real time; George Smith is Managing Director EMEA at Horizontal Digital; Matthew Lambert is Regional Alliances & Channels Director, Middle East at Salesforce; The initiative aims to support Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 digital modernization goals
